verdict.rationale: Reclaim automates calendar scheduling, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. The pack has no evidence of version history or rollback for its automation rules. The only related item is the 2.0 ability to 'preview changes in your calendar before deploying them', which is a one-time dry-run of schedule changes, not version control or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
